invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Drawable, choosing from available style fields or possibly null only if all are null.

invariants.expression: result == style.backgroundDisabled || result == style.backgroundOpen || result == style.backgroundOver || result == style.background
invariants.rationale: The result is always one of the style background drawables, as returned by the method.
The result is style.backgroundDisabled exactly when the SelectBox is disabled and that field is non-null.

invariants.expression: (result == style.backgroundOpen) == (!isDisabled() || style.backgroundDisabled == null) && scrollPane.hasParent() && style.backgroundOpen != null
invariants.rationale: The result is style.backgroundOpen exactly when the 'open' conditions are satisfied—and not already overridden by the 'disabled' case.

invariants.expression: (result == style.background) == (!isDisabled() || style.backgroundDisabled == null) && (!scrollPane.hasParent() || style.backgroundOpen == null) && (!isOver() || style.backgroundOver == null)
invariants.rationale: The background style is only returned if all other case conditions fail.
